headline: Fronts Intensify as Bases Trade Hands Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the 18:10 edition the war’s most volatile sectors have sharpened further. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest theatre, logging eight ownership changes in the last two hours and 59 in the past day, with both factions’ casualty rates accelerating above 1,100 and 970 per hour respectively. Stlican Shelf added two fresh flips in the last two hours and 41 daily transitions, losses climbing past 260 and 230 per hour. Stonecradle saw three new captures in the last two hours and 23 daily changes, colonial casualties surging to 643 per hour while warden losses hold near 515. Dead Lands recorded three recent events and 13 daily flips, casualty curves steepening to roughly 520 and 1,000 per hour. Linn Mercy posted two fresh events in the last two hours and 20 daily changes, both sides’ losses rising above 470 and 410 per hour. Godcrofts added two new flips in the last two hours, though casualty rates have cooled to single digits while enlistments rise. Meanwhile Viper Pit and Fisherman’s Row show no new two‑hour activity and declining casualty trends, indicating a temporary lull on those fronts.
